policy: Where one person may be another, both pages say so (RUL-0201). Where the owner has ruled that two are different people, neither page offers the other, however alike the two look.

pairs.why: Hobab the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law (NUM 10:29), is not Reuel, whom the text also calls Jethro: the son is not the father under a second name.
